summary_1line: Arjuna devastates the Samsaptakas, defeats Susarman, and advances toward Bhagadatta, whose elephant challenges him in a fierce chariot-versus-elephant duel.

image_candidates.scene_text: Arjuna unleashes the Brahma weapon as severed arms, banners, and warriors fall while elephants collapse across the battlefield.
Krishna drives the white, gold-armored horses as Arjuna rains arrows like a storm, scattering the surrounding army.
Bhagadatta charges atop a towering elephant while Arjuna stands in his chariot, the two circling each other in a tense car-versus-elephant duel.
